reason: The knob is live, but the proposed values change the output too much. Live: exp70g c0 l.16 sets it to 2. The c1 guard pins 2, and the builder (build_probe_kernel.py l.2966) rewrites that guard entry for --set keys. c2 l.48 reads it, c4 l.347 passes it on the CLI, and the c4 ILP patch hands it to td.solvers.ILPSolver. c3 hard-sets only the SECONDARY_*/DUAL_SEED_* knobs. safetail, lowrefine and divinsert all run after the ILP. It is not on the closed list, and no public read of it exists (exp13 was a local lab sweep on the old v2.1 pipeline). Size was measured, not guessed. exp80a's edge_cache/<ds>.npz holds the full ILP candidate graph (coords + admitted src/tgt/prob/dist). I re-solved it locally with tracksdata ILPSolver/SCIP, and D=2 reproduces the kernel's ILP solution exactly on all 4 visible clips. I then replayed exp70g's own filter_output_graph on CPU with the DeepCenter bundle set to None and divins off; parity with the real run is about 0.1-0.6%. Results at the proposed +-25%: D1.5 gives +2.03% output nodes over the 4 clips, and D2.5 gives -1.66%. The noisy clip 44b6_0b24845f alone moves +6.3% / -5.9% with 7-8% edge churn. So both proposed arms fail the arm's own |dnodes| <= 1.5% gate. At +-12.5%: D1.75 gives +0.85% nodes and 1.96% edge churn (per clip +0.21/+2.29/+0.53/+0.71%); D2.25 gives -0.76% nodes and 1.45% churn (per clip -0.05/-2.72/-0.58/-0.49%). That is the same size as JT's winners (<1%) and as exp85c READMIT 0.94 (+0.84%). Mechanism: under the no-merge flow identities the fork threshold is Div-A, so D is a pure fragment-mass threshold, keeping a component iff sum(p) > A+D. Relink, readmit and the MIN_TRACK_LEN 6 filter absorb most of the ILP swing on the clean clips but not on 44b6_0b24845f. Runtime: ILP solve time is within +-10% (5-90 s per clip) and post-processing time is unchanged, so there is no timing risk. Caveat: the public sign is unknowable locally. Most of the effect sits in one of the 4 public clips, so the read is noisy, and it is independent of pending probe 50: READMIT 0.94 adds sub-threshold peaks, while D decides which >= 0.965 candidates the ILP keeps.
fixed_values: UP 2.25 (+12.5%), DOWN 1.75 (-12.5%) instead of 2.5/1.5. The proposed values measured +2.03% / -1.66% output nodes, over the 1.5% gate, and +-6% on 44b6_0b24845f. The half steps measured +0.85% / -0.76% total. Re-check on the dummy run: |dnodes| vs exp70g <= 1.5% total.
